UML STATE MACHINE DIAGRAM: FIRMWARE HOST MCU & DISCONNECT CONTROL
Pemetaan State Operasi Host STM32U585 (fsm_statechart.c) & FSM Relai Pemutus Beban (SPLN D3.006:2021 / DLMS Class 70)
1. FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) UTAMA SISTEM FIRMWARE (Host STM32U585)

STATE 0: BOOT_INIT
entry / POR Catu Daya 3.3V
do / Init RCC 160MHz, SAU TrustZone
exit / Konfigurasi Pinout HAL Selesai

STATE 1: SELF_TEST
entry / Mulai Diagnostik Hardware
do / Checksum ROM/RAM, Ping SPI1 ADE9000, Uji Flash & Modem

STATE 2: NORMAL_METERING (Superstate Operasional Utama)
do / Akuisisi DSP 1s, Siklus Utama FreeRTOS 100 ms, Integrasi Maximum Demand (15m)
do / Evaluasi Tarif ToU, Carousel Display OLED, Respons Komunikasi DLMS/COSEM
do / Monitor Ambang Batas Daya & Tegangan (Over/Under Voltage Cut-off)

STATE 3: TAMPER_EVENT
entry / Catat Logbook Tamper FIFO
do / Nyalakan LED Kuning Alarm PB7
do / Kirim Trap Notifikasi DLMS ke HES

STATE 5: ACTUATION
entry / Siapkan Pulsa Koil Relai
do / Trigger PC8 (Trip) / PC9 (Close) 50ms
exit / Verifikasi Kontak Umpan Balik PC7

STATE 4: LAST_GASP_MODE
entry / Freeze Kalkulasi Metrologi ADE9000
do / Simpan Checkpoint Energi ke Flash SPI2
do / Transmisi Event Padam via DLMS
exit / Masuk Mode Ultra-Low-Power STOP 2
2. SUB-STATE MACHINE: PENGELOLA RELAI PEMUTUS BEBAN (SPLN D3.006 Tabel 5 & DLMS Disconnect Control Class 70)

CONNECTED (Relai Tersambung)
entry / Kontak Relai Tertutup (PC9 HIGH 50ms)
do / Saluran Listrik Pelanggan Aktif Normal
do / Evaluasi Beban Lebih & Cut-Off Tegangan

DISCONNECTED (Relai Terputus)
entry / Kontak Relai Terbuka (PC8 HIGH 50ms)
do / Saluran Beban Pelanggan Padam
do / Tampilkan Ikon Relai Terputus di OLED SPLN

READY_FOR_RECONNECTION (Siap Sambung)
entry / Perintah Reconnect Diterima dari HES/DLMS
do / Kedipkan Ikon Saklar di Layar OLED SPLN
do / Menunggu Aksi Fisik Pelanggan (SPLN Tabel 5 No 12)
